catalog.name: Vegeta
catalog.skill:
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Activate: Battle][Once per turn] Choose 1 red or blue ≪Saiyan≫ card in your hand and discard it: Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 <Son Goku: Br>, <Vegeta: Br>, or <Gogeta: Br> card among them to your hand, then place the remaining cards on top of your deck in any order.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less or you have 4 or more energy: You may draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, and flip this card over.
catalog.backSkill: [permanent] Red <Gogeta: Br> cards in your hand gain the following skill: ・[union-fusion]{r}{u}{2}: <Son Goku: Br> and <Vegeta: Br>. [auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card. [auto][once per turn] When you play a <Gogeta: Br> card, draw 1 card, then switch up to 1 of your Red/Blue multicolor energy to Active Mode at the end of the turn.
